name: Transitory Augmentation of Strength
description: One of the nine Transitory Augmentation Charms (one per Attribute), purchased and installed separately. Temporarily boosts Strength: add one dot per mote spent for a single instant-duration action, but never more dots than the Attribute's base rating. Installed for a Caste or Favored Attribute, it also reduces the anima die-boost cost from 3 motes to 2.

name: Sustained Augmentation of Strength
description: One of the nine Sustained Augmentation Charms (one per Attribute), installed separately. Grants one additional dot of Strength (part of the natural rating) and raises the Attribute's maximum by one. No single Attribute may be augmented this way more than once, but any number of different Attributes may be.
